title: Code 1
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: know the basic concepts of interactive audio-visual applications.
understand basic information structures for interactive 2D-graphics and audio as implemented by web-technologies.
work with a programming language and use software development and source control environments.
analyse simple human-computer-interactions and use computational thinking to formulate algorithms for their realization
be creative and experiment with procedural coding, web- and other technologies
evaluate and improve their coded creations
